question: Which saved original39 primary-input families does the frozen model-to-EMA/HOLD f696 cash proposal depend on, and do those fixed family sensitivities differ in weak and good windows within the same prior trend and year?

method.identity_gate: Load only bridge-pinned original39 Qlib features, common inputs, outer_refit model, market, raw predictions and source targets. Recompute exact raw five outputs and exact EMA/HOLD f696 target on 944 dates within 1e-7 before any neutralization.
method.neutralization: For each original39 primary-input column, on all 944 held signal dates replace only that primary column by the sealed outer_refit primary_scaler mean; keep the separate common-input frame, all other features, model weights, historical source returns and EMA/HOLD settings fixed.
method.runs: Exactly 39 single-column and 3 whole-family forward plus EMA/HOLD replays. Report all 39 in original order without selecting a winner. A family replay is nonlinear and need not equal the sum of singles.
method.measures: For every run report absolute and signed change in f696 accepted cash proposal, and absolute changes in SOXL/SOXX proposals. For each family report annual mean signed cash change and matched weak-minus-good change over all819 rolling126 windows using the frozen interval-card start-state/year definition.
method.scope: All 944 held exact-f696 signal dates, 2023/2026 partial endpoints, complete 2024/2025, 16 source quarters and819 overlapping rolling126 windows; 2023 has no same-year good windows and stays unmatched.
method.stop: Stop before neutralization if source hashes/NAS, model raw-forward, EMA/HOLD target parity, 39-feature order, 944 dates, Qlib calendar, or training-scaler means fail. Stop after exactly 42 replays; no feature threshold or economic account.

interpretation: Ablation to a training mean is off the joint input manifold and measures frozen model path dependence, not causal market importance, incremental information, expected return or an executable policy. Reused weak/good windows cannot select a tradable factor; any new mechanism needs a separate information gate and its own full 0bp Tiered account.
